title: settings.json does not allow the read-only selfdoc.py section command
goal: The allow list of .claude/settings.json holds Bash and PowerShell rules for python3 _tools/selfdoc.py section *, so a skill or subagent reads a doc section without a permission prompt, and test_powershell_rules_mirror_bash still passes

run: import json,sys; a=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json'))['permissions']['allow']; sys.exit(0 if 'Bash(python3 _tools/selfdoc.py section *)' in a and 'PowerShell(python3 _tools/selfdoc.py section *)' in a else 1)
